newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rubber prices up as rain hits supply.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rubber prices up as rain hits supply.

text.p: Prices at the Colombo rubber auctions remained high as heavy monsoon rains continued to cut supply, traders said.
"The monsoon, which usually eases in mid-July, continued well into the third week, cutting tapping to about six days in the last five weeks," said a trader at produce brokers Forbes & Walker.
Best latex one-x was unquoted, brokers said. Number one was at 83.50 per kg and number two at 79.25.
On offer was 115 tonnes, which was a below-average quantity, brokers said. "With quantities seen falling further due to rain, there were a lot of forward sales," said one. ($1=58.5).
